POP Series 9

Released March 1, 2009 · 17 cards

POP Series 9 is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the POP series, released in English on March 1, 2009. It has 17 cards. It includes 17 Pokémon, 0 Trainer and 0 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.
